title: Evaluating Compositional Generalisation in VLMs and Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models in Generalised Zero-Shot Learning (GZSL) settings to measure their tendency to disproportionately predict familiar, in-distribution attribute-object combinations (seen labels) over novel, out-of-distribution combinations (unseen labels).

Testing models using hard negative distractors in relational tasks (e.g., 'cube left sphere' vs. 'sphere left cube') to determine if they rely on bag-of-words object recognition shortcuts rather than forming structured, compositional representations of spatial relations.
